text.wealthPower481: function wealthPower481(list,pTotal){let covered=0,weighted=0;for(const i of list){const b=tiles[i]?.bld;if(!b||b.ref)continue;let pp=0,w=1;if([1,127,33,105].includes(b.k)){pp=residentPopulation488(i,b);if(b.k===1){const we=b.we!==undefined?b.we:1;w=we===0?.72:we===2?1.28:1;}else if(b.k===127)w=.72;else if(b.k===33)w=1.08;else w=1.12;}if(pp>0){covered+=pp;weighted+=pp*w;}}const rest=Math.max(0,pTotal-covered);return pTotal>0?clamp((weighted+rest)/pTotal,.65,1.35):1;}
